c-member-link-preview.1.evidence: bob topic 'QA-WALK-B Release notes worth reading' with https://wordpress.org/news/ (created through REST POST /spaces/2999/posts, not typed into the composer): published page shows a card with site name WORDPRESS NEWS, title 'WordPress News', description and a 558px image

c-member-link-preview.2.evidence: bob GET /link-preview?url=https://wordpress.org/news/ -> 200 with title, description, image, site_name, favicon and provider 'generic'

c-member-link-preview.3.evidence: YouTube URL shows the oEmbed player (iframe youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ?feature=oembed, .jt-embed). An X post URL (x.com and twitter.com .../WordPress/status/1795513131453583543) comes back provider 'twitter' with empty title, image and embed_html, so no X card renders; I could not confirm a real live post ID, so this may be the fixture URL

c-member-link-preview.4.evidence: Guest view of the same topics: identical card (same class, 558x314 image, same text) and the same YouTube iframe

c-member-link-preview.5.evidence: bob GET /link-preview for http://localhost/, http://127.0.0.1/, http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/, http://10.0.0.5/ and file:///etc/passwd: all 200 with identical empty preview (no title, description, image or embed)

c-member-link-preview.6.evidence: http://localtest.me/ and http://127.0.0.1.nip.io/ (public names resolving to 127.0.0.1) and an httpbin redirect-to http://127.0.0.1/ all return the same empty 200 preview; no content leaked

c-member-link-preview.7.evidence: https://httpbin.org/delay/20: /link-preview gave up at 6.06 s with an empty preview; creating a topic containing that URL returned 201 in 5.07 s and the page shows a plain link with no card

c-member-link-preview.8.evidence: https://httpbin.org/status/500: 200 empty preview in 3.1 s, no PHP error, an immediate retry came back in 0.06 s (negative cache, 10 minutes per class-preview-service.php)

c-member-link-preview.9.evidence: Second GET for the same URL took 0.04 s and returned identical JSON (12-hour cache)

c-member-link-preview.10.evidence: Redirect loop (httpbin redirect-to chain) and a 6-hop chain (httpbin /redirect/6) both returned 200 with an empty preview after 6.8 s and 14.1 s, not 400 'Redirect loop or invalid redirect.' / 'Too many redirects.'; the WP_Errors from class-html-fetcher.php:101/125 are swallowed by the preview service

c-member-link-preview.11.evidence: Guest GET /link-preview for http://127.0.0.1/ -> 200 identical empty preview, nothing fetched

c-member-link-preview.12.evidence: 145-character unbroken URL topic at 390: page scrollWidth 390; the link text wraps (overflow-wrap anywhere, 134px tall, 292px wide) inside the post

c-member-link-preview.13.evidence: Card at 390: image 292x164 scales to the column, title wraps, the whole card is an anchor 313px tall (tap target well above 40px), no sideways scroll

c-member-link-preview.14.evidence: Dark mode card background rgb(47,49,58)-ish on the dark surface rgb(35,38,47), title text stays light; checked via computed colours at 390

c-member-link-preview.15.evidence: Link to ar.wordpress.org: card title is Arabic, dir=auto resolves to rtl, text-align start (right on RTL text)

c-member-link-preview.16.evidence: Guest GET /link-preview for 40 different public URLs (example.com?qawalkb=N) in 66 s: every one 200, no 401 and no 429, so the endpoint is an open server-side fetch for logged-out visitors
